dose.text: CD spectroscopy Samples containing 40 μM CsgA in 50 mM potassium phosphate buffer (KPi) and 0.02% NaN3, pH 7.2, with and without 10 μM LL-37 were incubated for 60 h at 37°C.

endpoint.text: (A) Adhesion capacity and thickness of biofilm produced by E. coli isolates collected from urine of patients with urinary tract infections (UTI, n = 99) and from fecal samples of healthy individuals (Fecal, n = 77) was measured.
The dye was solubilized with ethanol (95%) and the optical density was measured at 570 nm.
Fluorescence intensity was quantified using ImageJ software [61].

reported_results.text: expression of curli alone increased the induction of MIP-2 (P = 0.001, Figure 2F).
In curliated bacteria, the expression of cellulose reduced IL8 induction (** P = 0.001, t-test).

While the number of viable curliated bacteria did not differ after 30 min (Figure 4C, left), the number of bacteria lacking curli was significantly higher in the presence of LL-37-specific antibodies compared to the samples treated with an irrelevant isotype control antibody (Figure 4C, right, P = 0.047).
The difference between LL-37 versus sLL-37 or VIP at 2.5 μM was statistically significant (*** P = 0.001, ttest).
(B) At 2.5 μM, LL-37 caused more than 80% reduction of biofilm production, whereas the same concentration of the control peptides gave a reduction of only ∼10%.
